name: HZ_EMPLOYMENT_HISTORY
description: The HZ_EMPLOYMENT_HISTORY table stores information about the employment and military service history of a party of the PERSON type. For example, This table would be used to store the employment information for John Smith, an accountant, whose supervisor was Jane Doe and worked in U.S. Operations division of Vision Corporation from July 12, 1994 to January 23 2000

columns.name: EMPLOYMENT_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Unique employment history identifier.

columns.name: BEGIN_DATE
columns.description: The date that the employment officially began.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party identifier. Foreign key to the HZ_PARTIES table

columns.name: EMPLOYED_AS_TITLE
columns.description: Job position title assigned by an employer

columns.name: EMPLOYED_BY_DIVISION_NAME
columns.description: The common name of a division or an organization in which the person was employed.

columns.name: EMPLOYED_BY_NAME_COMPANY
columns.description: The name of the organization at which the person was employeed.  Note that the name should not include the division name.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The date that the employment officially ended.

columns.name: SUPERVISOR_NAME
columns.description: Full name of the person's manager

columns.name: BRANCH
columns.description: Military branch code

columns.name: MILITARY_RANK
columns.description: The person's rank in the branch

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: SERVED
columns.description: Where the person performed military service

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: STATION
columns.description: Station name

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: RESPONSIBILITY
columns.description: Job responsibility of the person

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Record status flag

columns.name: EMPLOYED_BY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party identifier of the employer for situations in which the employer is represented as a party

columns.name: REASON_FOR_LEAVING
columns.description: Free-format text describing the reason for leaving

columns.name: FACULTY_POSITION_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the position is a faculty position or not

columns.name: TENURE_CODE
columns.description: Type of tenure for faculty positions

columns.name: FRACTION_OF_TENURE
columns.description: Fraction of tenure

columns.name: EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the employment is part-time or full-time

columns.name: EMPLOYED_AS_TITLE_CODE
columns.description: Code for the job title.  If title cannot be represented by a code, then the EMPLOYED_AS_TITLE column should be used.

columns.name: WEEKLY_WORK_HOURS
columns.description: Usual number of hours worked per week

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: General comments about the employment history

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.description: Identifier for the source application module that created this record

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
